noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

skipOnChange.description:
When set true on a field, the {@link MutableObj#onChange} will be skipped. Similar to wrapping
{@link MutableObj#withoutChangeEvent} on the field change statement.

title: Annotation to define behavior for {@link MutableObj} instances on field change.
name: Ann.Mutable
